notes.title: Tutorial update
notes.notes:
Added a new game tutorial with 5 levels:
[olist]
 Cursor manipulation
 Main weapons (Gun & Laser)
 Turrets placement
 Buildings on base
 Pointers to enemy waves
[/olist]

Turrets can be built on sphere around base - just build them.
By default new turrets are placed on sphere around base. But you still can place them manually using T+Space.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812293/f10c0c60d0c1f48b3567edbee725e4ec7f6e577c.png

New UI  pointers - arrow to enemy gate.

And many other UI, performance, gameplay, balance, achievements improvements
